prompt: What is the street address of the building where the first meeting of the Gay Men's Chorus of Washington, D.C., was held in 1981?
answer: The first meeting of the Gay Men’s Chorus of Washington, D.C., was held at the **Church of the Holy City, 1611 16th Street NW, Washington, D.C.**
